title: The Seventh Door
text: Six doors in the Shrine each lead to a god, each carved with that god's sign. A seventh, unmarked and older than the rest, stands ajar. Cold air comes through the gap with a smell like turned earth.

options.label: Go through the seventh door to meet whatever no one prays to.

outcomes.text: A god no one prays to is glad of visitors. Its gifts are strange.
Something that is not a god waits behind it.

options.label: The wisest chooses one of the six, trusting the gods they know.

outcomes.text: They choose rightly. Warm light waits behind it.

options.label: Shut the seventh door before whatever lies behind it comes through.

outcomes.text: It does not want to shut. It takes all of you, and every arm aches for days.
